Class 11 Physics · Mechanical Properties of Fluids (dynamic lift)
Physics, visualised #6

One machine, one speed (26 m/s at 14°), three spins.
No spin lands at 25.6 m: out (the court is 23.77 m). Backspin floats to 33 m: way out. Topspin clears the net and dips in at 20.1 m → A.
Why: a spinning ball drags the air round and throws it off one way. Topspin throws the air up, so the ball is pushed down (the Magnus effect). Backspin: air down, ball up.
That's why players hit topspin.
